credit: Epic quest steps transcribed from eqlwiki.com's class epic pages (Shadow Knight, Shaman, Enchanter); step-tracking design EQL Assistant.
notice: Before Kunark (8 Dec): these steps come from eqlwiki's classic-era walkthroughs and are unverified in EQ Legends. A name the game spells differently will not tick by itself — tick the step by hand; the steps get corrected once the epics are live.
footer: 3 of 15 class epics so far: Shadow Knight, Shaman, Enchanter. Still to come: Bard, Berserker, Cleric, Druid, Magician, Monk, Necromancer, Paladin, Ranger, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard. eqlwiki has no Beastlord epic page yet.

quests.name: Shadow Knight Epic
quests.rewardStats:
MAGIC ITEM LORE ITEM NO DROP
Slot: PRIMARY
Skill: 2H Slashing Atk Delay: 45
DMG: 40
STR: +20 DEX: +15 INT: +15 HP: +60 MANA: +40
SV FIRE: +10 SV DISEASE: +5 SV COLD: +10 SV MAGIC: +15 SV POISON: +5
Effect: Soul Consumption (Combat, Casting Time: Instant, Req Level 50)
WT: 5.0 Size: SMALL
Class: SHD
Race: ALL
quests.warning: Con INDIFFERENT to every hand-in NPC before you press Trade: items in the window, then Hide or invisibility, then check the con. A hand-in at a worse con is eaten.
quests.note: The Letter to Duriek and The Dusty Tome are not required.

steps.title: Hail Kurron Ni
Hand Kurron Ni the three Darkforge pieces and 900 platinum
steps.note: The armor comes from the Darkforge Armor quests.

steps.title: Kill Kurron Ni for the Letter to Duriek
Hand Duriek Bloodpool the letter
steps.caution: Con indifferent first — put the items in the window, hide, then check the con.

steps.title: Hail Smaka
Pay Smaka 1000 platinum for a Cough Elixir
Hand Duriek the Cough Elixir
steps.caution: Con indifferent first — put the items in the window, hide, then check the con.

steps.title: Kill a ratman guard for a Dusty Tome
Hand Duriek the Dusty Tome
steps.caution: Con indifferent first — put the items in the window, hide, then check the con.

steps.title: Kill the froglok shin lord for the Ghoulbane
Kill a Fear golem for the Soul Leech, Dark Sword of Blood
loot: Soul Leech, Dark Sword of Blood
steps.note: Cazic-Thule carried it before the Fear revamp.

steps.title: Loot a Blade of Abrogation in the Plane of Sky
Kill Rharzar for a Drake Spine
Kill an ashenbone drake for a Decrepit Hide
Buy a Platinum Bar and have an enchanter enchant it
Hand Teydar the spine, the hide and the bar
steps.zone: Qeynos Aqueducts, the evil guild area
steps.caution: Con indifferent first — put the items in the window, hide, then check the con.

steps.title: Hand Duriek the three swords and the sheath

handin.name: Soul Leech, Dark Sword of Blood

steps.caution: Con indifferent first — put the items in the window, hide, then check the con.

steps.title: Hail Lhranc
Ask Marl Kastane about the prophecy for a Seal of Kastane
steps.note: Say "I have the will of Innoruuk" first.

steps.title: Hand Gerot Kastane the Seal of Kastane
Hand Marl Kastane the Note to Marl
Ask Knarthenne Skurl about the heart of an innocent for a Soulcase
Kill a mimic for a Cell Key
steps.note: It looks like a chest.

steps.title: Hand Caradon the Cell Key
steps.note: This spawns Kyrenna.
steps.caution: Con indifferent first — put the items in the window, hide, then check the con.

steps.title: Kill Kyrenna for her blood and her heart
steps.note: Kill Kyrenna, not Caradon, if it can be avoided.

steps.title: Hand Marl Kastane the Blood of Kyrenna
steps.caution: Con indifferent first — hide, and never feign death on this hand-in.

steps.title: Hand the Ghost of Glohnor the Dark Shroud
steps.caution: Con indifferent with invisibility to undead before you trade.

steps.title: Kill the Mummy of Glohnor for his head and wrappings
Hand Gerot Kastane the Head of Glohnor
steps.caution: Con indifferent first — put the items in the window, hide, then check the con.

steps.title: Hand Marl Kastane the Glohnor wrappings
steps.caution: Con indifferent first — put the items in the window, hide, then check the con.

steps.title: Combine the Heart of Kyrenna in the Soulcase
Hand Lhranc the Corrupted Ghoulbane, the heart, the head and the will
steps.caution: Con indifferent first — have someone cast invisibility to undead on you. He returns with the sword: bring at least two groups.

steps.title: Kill Lhranc and loot Innoruuk's Curse
steps.note: If you wipe, Lhranc does not despawn.

quests.name: Shaman Epic
quests.rewardStats:
MAGIC ITEM LORE ITEM NO DROP REQUIRED LEVEL OF 46.
Slot: PRIMARY
Skill: Piercing Atk Delay: 30
DMG: 20
STR: +10 DEX: +10 STA: +10 WIS: +20 HP: +30 MANA: +70
SV FIRE: +10 SV DISEASE: +10 SV COLD: +10 SV MAGIC: +10 SV POISON: +10
Effect: Curse of the Spirits (Must Equip, Casting Time: 9.0, Req Level 50)
WT: 1.0 Size: MEDIUM
Class: SHM
Race: ALL
quests.warning: True Spirit faction carries this quest: about amiable to move along, and MAX ally for the final scale — below that the scale is eaten.
quests.note: The wiki's page does not name the three books, Kirn's ring or the diary; those steps tick on the trade or by hand.

steps.title: Kill one of the four to call a lesser spirit
steps.zone: Ocean of Tears · Rathe Mountains · Butcherblock Mountains · Field of Bone
steps.note: A lesser spirit appears where it dies. Do not kill the spirit.

steps.title: Tell the lesser spirit you wish to know more
Hand Bondl Felligan the Tiny Gem
steps.note: He leads you to the Jade Tiger, where the greater spirits appear.

steps.title: Question the greater spirit of your god until it gives the Opaque Gem
steps.caution: Say "I will walk the path of the Heyokah" only once you hold the gem — the spirit leaves at once.

steps.title: Hand Ooglyn the Opaque Gem
steps.note: Her spawn takes two hours.

steps.title: Hear out the drowned, then ask the greater spirit for the next path
steps.note: Only one shaman can take the test at a time.

steps.title: Hand a wandering spirit the Small Gem
steps.note: It looks like a brighter wisp and roams between Qeynos Hills and the bandit camp.

steps.title: Kill Glaron the Wicked and Tabien the Goodly
Hand the wandering spirit Envy, Woe and Marr's Promise
steps.note: Ask "What shield of falsehood?" and "What last path?".

steps.title: Hand the Spirit Sentinel the Sparkling Gem
Kill Black Dire for his pelt
steps.note: Killing an advisor in the library calls him.

steps.title: Hand the Spirit Sentinel the Black Dire Pelt
steps.note: He also hands you a six-slot booklet.

steps.title: Loot the six reports in the City of Mist
steps.note: The Student's Log drops only from a spectral courier.

steps.title: Combine the six reports in the booklet
Hand the Spirit Sentinel the completed report
Kill Lord Ghiosk and loot his three books
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Hand the three books to the Spirit Sentinel in the pond
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk
steps.caution: Not the Spirit Sentinel near the City of Mist — the one in the pond.

steps.title: Pick up the Icon of the High Scale
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Hand High Scale Kirn the icon
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Kill High Scale Kirn and loot his ring
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Hand Neh`Ashiir the ring
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Kill Neh`Ashiir and loot her diary
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Hand the Spirit Sentinel the diary
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Kill the Iksar Broodling for a Child's Tear
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk
steps.note: It appears at random when a golem dies — Dread, Fright or Terror.

steps.title: Hand Lord Rak`Ashiir the Child's Tear
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk
steps.note: Ally is enough here; it need not be maxed.

steps.title: Kill Lord Rak`Ashiir for his Iksar Scale
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk

steps.title: Hand the Spirit Sentinel in the pond the Iksar Scale
steps.part: The Three Books of Lord Ghiosk
steps.caution: MAX ally, not just ally, or the scale is eaten — wait for "Your faction with True Spirit can not get any better".
